registration.question: On the 164 SONICOM development subjects, does adding the head mesh outside both ear crops (REST) to the current geometry (nine measures + ear embedding, GEO) improve the prediction of the measured HRTF?

sources.GEO: FFM_3_8 geometry_blocks(): nine measures + ear-crop RFF mean embedding at 5 scales (unchanged)
sources.REST: all head_pts with z > -75 mm and farther than 45 mm from both ear canals, first 20000 of those, head frame, whole head mirrored (y -> -y) for right-ear rows; RFF mean embedding at the 5 scales of GEO
sources.HEADM: head width (y range at |z| < 20 mm, 0.5-99.5 pct), back of head (-x 0.5 pct), front of head (x 99.5 pct), convex-hull volume, canal x minus median head x; from head points with z > -75 mm

registration.weighting: each source unit-scaled and added (FFM_3_8 source_kernel), so every source has the same weight; R5 scales REST by w

rows.R5: GEO + w*REST, w in W_GRID and alpha chosen jointly by the inner CV of each outer training fold (primary)
rows.C1: R5 with REST permuted across subjects (both ears together), 100 permutations (seeds 0-99), w and alpha re-chosen

registration.targets: measured latent (primary); simulated latent (SONICOM_SIM, diagnostic, same rows and rules)
registration.primary_metric: LSD, bins 1-85 (DC excluded), elevation >= -45 deg; per subject = mean of both ears
registration.primary_test: LSD(R5) - LSD(R1), paired over subjects: bootstrap 95% CI (2000), one-sided paired t; C1 null of the same difference, p_C1 = (1 + #{C1 <= observed}) / 101
registration.reading: the head beyond the ear crops improves the prediction of the measured HRTF only if LSD(R5) - LSD(R1) <= -1% of R0's LSD (about -0.046 dB), its CI is below 0 and p_C1 <= 0.05; otherwise adding REST does not improve the full-band prediction by 1% or more (this alone does not say that REST carries no low-frequency information)
secondary: dR2_low = CV-R2(R5) - CV-R2(R1), measured latent, 0.2-5 kHz columns, SSE and SST summed over subjects; subject bootstrap CI and C1 null; read as low-band information only if >= +0.02, CI above 0 and above the C1 95th percentile

ratio dR2_low,meas / dR2_low,sim (same bootstrap draws), predicted about 1/3.1 = 0.32; interpreted only if the CI of dR2_low,sim is above 0: a CI containing 0.32 supports measured = shape part + independent rest, one clearly above contradicts it
descriptive: per-band R2 and LSD of every row on both targets, w per fold, REST point counts, HEADM distributions
registration.bands: Task 1: 0.2-5 kHz bins 2-26, 6-12 kHz bins 32-64, 12-16 kHz bins 64-85 (limits included); 5-6 kHz bins 27-31 descriptive; full-band statistics use all bins
registration.expectation: full-band dLSD within +-0.01 dB; measured dR2_low below +0.02; the simulated target may gain more
registration.data: development only; the 36 locked subjects were spent on 2026-10-12 (FFM_3_8) and are not read

ratio.reading: CI below 1/3.1 (not covered by the registered reading; descriptive)

verdict.primary: adding REST does not improve the full-band prediction by 1% or more
verdict.low_band: no registered evidence that REST adds low-band information on the measured latent
verdict.ratio: CI below 1/3.1 (not covered by the registered reading; descriptive)
